description: Checks an invent_game job: pending (with progress), ready (with the template and its certification), or failed (with the problems). Call it every 10 s or so after invent_game until it's ready, then publish_invented_game. The template's outcomes[].pay are relative weights, not LP; certification.outcomes[].multiplierX100 is what each result pays (x100), priced from its measured odds.
name: invent_status
title: An invented game's progress
